_comment: Unacknowledged step-internal FAIL/MISSING reports across the PUBLISHED (git-tracked) run trees — a run tree being any directory that owns a tracked reports/**/*.json, which is what the gate can read, NOT a directory whose name matches a convention (vibe-ic#1223). MAY ONLY SHRINK UNDER A FIXED POPULATION — each one is a report declaring FAIL that no waiver and no orchestrator record names. The wrong repair is to loosen the matcher until the number falls (vibe-ic#693). `corpus_population` is the root this count was taken over and is part of the record: the gate refuses to ratchet a count from one population against a sweep of another.
_withdrawn_comment: Findings that left findings_total because their run left the published corpus (or stopped carrying a reports/ tree), NOT because anyone examined them (vibe-ic#1202). Recorded so a fall in findings_total can never be read as debt paid. These reports still declare FAIL. NOT part of findings_total and not a ceiling on anything — the ratchet is over the published corpus only.
_absent_comment: Findings whose run tree is NOT UNDER THE SWEPT CORPUS at all, so this gate never opened it (vibe-ic#1704). Separate from withdrawn_unexamined, which names run trees the sweep DID open and found publishing no reports/ file it reads. Whether these were removed from publication or were never published into this corpus is not something a sweep of one corpus can tell; `shrink_reason` is where that is stated by whoever looked. NOT part of findings_total and not a ceiling on anything.
shrink_reason: vibe-ic#2000: benchmark-data remote main is 9e4ad95cf74f and commit bcf2f94c withdrew u_hawaii_adc/v1.9.86_sky130A because it carried contradictory PASS and FAIL completion audits; its one unacknowledged internal FAIL was not repaired or re-read and remains recorded as absent_from_corpus.
_withdrawn_provenance: Re-derived from git, not re-measured: 94c7572aa moved this file 7 -> 5 and its diff shows both sha256 runs UNCHANGED (2 and 3) while both u_hawaii_adc runs left. Zero repaired, two withdrawn. Replaying that commit's parent baseline through the fixed gate against the corpus at 75776dbbb reproduces exactly these two entries.
_population_shrink_comment: WHY THE NUMBERS ABOVE MOVED, itemised (vibe-ic#1704). `findings_total`, `runs_swept` and `runs_with_reports` are a ratchet, and a ratchet whose number can fall without anyone saying why is a record of nothing. `withdrawn_unexamined` already refuses to let a FALLING NUMERATOR be read as debt somebody paid (vibe-ic#1202); it says nothing about the DENOMINATOR, and a denominator that drops because runs were never published is a different fact from one that drops because runs were deleted. `_population_shrink` states which, per departed run, and the equations it must satisfy are pinned by programs/tests/test_issue1704_a_moved_ratchet_states_its_cause.py — so the next `--write-baseline` that moves a number and leaves this block behind is RED, not silent. Reasons come from a closed vocabulary: `not_published_layout` (the run tree is not a `v<version>_<PDK>` cell, so the publishing contract admits no such directory), `not_published_verdict` (it IS a cell and its own RESULT.md reads FAIL), `publication_withdrawn` (the whole cell was removed by an explicit publication decision while its source bytes remain), `deleted` (the bytes are gone from the source history too), `reports_withdrawn` (the run is still published but stopped carrying a reports/ tree).
_population_shrink_provenance: MEASURED by this gate's own `check_corpus`. FROM: the previously recorded published population, 4 run trees and 1 finding. TO: vibeic/benchmark-data remote main 9e4ad95cf74fd3c4843701a981c3cdfdbe3c967c, 2 run trees and 0 findings. Publication commit bcf2f94c removed three named cells without re-reading or repairing their reports; u_hawaii_adc/v1.9.86_sky130A carried the one finding and remains on `absent_from_corpus`. Publication commit a467106a added spm/v1.5.65_sky130A carrying no finding. Thus 4 - 3 + 1 = 2 run trees and 1 - 1 + 0 = 0 findings; no fall is represented as engineering repair.
